blocks.subtitle: Sell More. Reach Further. Grow Faster.
paragraphs: Launch a powerful, conversion-optimized online store that works for your business around the clock. True Line builds e-commerce websites that look great, load fast, and are designed to turn visitors into buyers — on every device, every time.

blocks.title: Your Online Store, Built to Sell
paragraphs: The shift to online commerce isn't slowing down — and businesses that invest in the right e-commerce platform are the ones winning. But not all online stores are created equal. A slow, poorly designed, or hard-to-manage store can cost you customers, revenue, and reputation.

True Line builds e-commerce websites tailored to your products, your customers, and your business model. Whether you're launching your first online store, migrating from an existing platform, or building a fully custom e-commerce solution, we design and develop experiences that make buying easy, build trust, and drive consistent sales.
From product catalog and payment integration to order management and logistics connectivity, we handle every layer of your e-commerce project — so you can focus on growing your business.

blocks.title: Platforms We Work With
blocks.lead: We recommend the right platform for your business — not the one we're most familiar with.

items.title: WooCommerce
items.text: The most popular e-commerce platform for WordPress. Flexible, cost-effective, and ideal for small to medium businesses wanting full control.
items.bestFor: SMEs, content-heavy stores, businesses already on WordPress

items.title: Shopify
items.text: A fully hosted, easy-to-manage platform with a rich app ecosystem. Ideal for businesses that want to launch fast and scale quickly.
items.bestFor: Fast launches, growing retail brands, multi-channel selling

items.title: Magento / Adobe Commerce
items.text: Enterprise-grade e-commerce for large catalogs, complex pricing rules, and high-traffic stores.
items.bestFor: Large retailers, multi-store setups, B2B commerce

items.title: Custom E-Commerce (React / Next.js)
items.text: Fully bespoke e-commerce platforms built from scratch for businesses with unique requirements that off-the-shelf platforms can't handle.
items.bestFor: Unique business models, marketplace platforms, ERP-integrated commerce

items.title: ERPNext E-Commerce
items.text: Native ERPNext web store integration for businesses already running on ERPNext — real-time inventory, pricing, and order sync out of the box.
items.bestFor: ERPNext users wanting a connected online store

blocks.title: How We Build Your Online Store

steps.title: Platform Selection
steps.text: We recommend the best platform based on your budget, product catalog, business model, and growth plans.

steps.title: UI/UX Design
steps.text: We design a shopping experience that reflects your brand and is optimized for conversions — reviewed and approved before development.

steps.title: Development & Configuration
steps.text: Your store is built, configured, and customized — from product catalog and payment setup to shipping rules and tax configuration.

steps.title: Content & Product Upload
steps.text: We help structure your product data, categories, and content for maximum impact and SEO performance.

steps.title: Integration & Testing
steps.text: Payment gateways, shipping providers, ERP connections, and third-party tools are integrated and thoroughly tested.

steps.title: Launch
